interpretation.diagram_classification: cosmological / astronomical (computistic) diagram, probably a lunar–solar or eclipse diagram
interpretation.interpretation: The diagram appears to show the relation of the sun and the moon to a central earth. The red-rayed round figure with a face at the top is a personified sun. The brown circle with a red outline at the centre is the earth. The two crescents at left and right, and the double-outlined brown circle at the bottom, are probably the moon in different phases or positions, perhaps including a darkened or eclipsed moon. The wide hatched ring with the circle of red dots and the many radiating lines is most likely a graduated scale. It would divide the heavens or the day into equal parts (hours or degrees) and be used to read the positions of the sun and moon. The short red rays outside the ring suggest light radiating from the sun. The star outline at the left may be a marginal mark or a star or planet. The text at the top refers to "ein stunde" (an hour) and to what is written "in disser [figure]", so the diagram is probably tied to the calculation of hours or time, perhaps for an eclipse, in a German-language astronomical or calendrical manuscript.
interpretation.evidence: The sun is identified by its face and its red triangular rays. The central circle is surrounded by concentric circles and a graduated ring, which is typical of astronomical and computistic schemes. The crescents are lunar in shape. The transcribed text at the top mentions an hour ("stunde") and a figure or diagram, which supports a time-reckoning reading. The text is partly illegible, so the reading cannot be confirmed. The identification of the star, the bottom circle and the exact function of the dots and lines is uncertain. In Step 1, several entries use 'connected_to' for crescents and rays that only touch or lie close to the ring. The star entry also links it to the radiating lines on weak grounds. The lower circle is described there only as a 'bottom ring with face'. These entries are therefore weak and are not relied on here.
